description: This file defines the class 'One2MRelationship', representing a one-to-many relationship in a CRM system, extending the 'M2MRelationship' class. It includes constructor logic for setting up relationship links and methods for adding relationships while handling self-referencing cases.

classes.name: One2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a one-to-many relationship that is table-based, capable of handling self-referencing cases, and extending the functionality of a many-to-many relationship class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object, determining link definitions for lhs and rhs modules, handling self-referencing relationships, and setting link names.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship between two Beans, handling self-references and ensuring existing relationships are not duplicated.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: Override to prevent default self-referencing add behavior; implemented as a no-op.

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: Override to prevent default self-referencing remove behavior; implemented as a no-op.
